# True positive secret samples for manual testing.
# IMPORTANT: Do NOT place full sensitive tokens here.
# Use the test script (tests/hooks/test-secret-patterns.sh) for runtime construction.

# AWS Access Key ID format: AKIA + 16 uppercase alphanumeric chars
# Example prefix: AKIA
# Full example (safe — fictional): AKIAIOSFODNN7EXAMPLE

# Slack Bot Token format: xoxb- + digits + digits + alphanum
# Construct at runtime: SLACK_P="xoxb-"; SLACK_B="123456789012-1234567890123-abcdef"

# Stripe Secret Key format: sk_live_ + 24+ alphanum
# Construct at runtime: STRIPE_P="sk_live_"; STRIPE_B="abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwx"

# Google API Key format: AIza + 35 alphanum/dash/underscore
# Construct at runtime: GOOGLE_P="AIza"; GOOGLE_B="SyDkfk9q1Qo8BxX2jqk7vqNJzKlMnOpQrStUv"
